edges.reason: msg.sender is read for blacklist checks and fee exclusions in _transfer, which relies purely on caller identity
enableDisableDevFee gates on msg.sender == liquidityWallet, allowing that wallet to disable the dev fee
processAccount records lastClaimTimes[account] = block.timestamp, a timestamp dependence controlling claim eligibility
tx.origin is captured into the ProcessedDividendTracker event inside _transfer
tx.origin is used to attribute the dividend processing loop in the main contract
block.timestamp is passed as the Uniswap deadline in swapTokensForDividendToken
block.timestamp is passed as the Uniswap deadline in swapTokensForEth
setBalance indirectly drives timestamp-based auto-claiming through processAccount
swapAndSendToDev performs transfer(newBalance) to the hardcoded dev address
swapTokensForDividendToken makes the external router swap call
swapTokensForEth makes the external router swap call
_withdrawDividendOfUser performs an external ERC20 transfer before the state is fully settled, allowing reentrancy
swapAndSendDividends performs the external ERC20 transfer of dividend tokens to the tracker
setDividendTokenAddress has no access control, enabling anyone to redirect the dividend token
setDividendTokenAddress writes the caller-supplied address into dividendToken
_transfer calls swapAndSendToDev during liquidation of contract tokens
_transfer calls swapAndSendDividends during liquidation of contract tokens
_transfer makes an external call to dividendTracker.setBalance synchronizing holder balances
_transfer makes an external call to dividendTracker.process, a callback into the tracker contract
swapAndSendDividends calls swapTokensForDividendToken to obtain dividend tokens
swapAndSendDividends calls dividendTracker.distributeDividends after transferring tokens
swapAndSendToDev calls swapTokensForEth to convert tokens into ETH
withdrawDividend delegates to _withdrawDividendOfUser for msg.sender
processAccount calls _withdrawDividendOfUser to pay out dividends
setBalance calls processAccount after updating the holder balance
process calls processAccount for each eligible holder inside the gas loop
the liquidating flag is used as a reentrancy guard around swap/dividend callbacks in _transfer
_isBlackListedBot gates transfers in _transfer
tradingEnabled controls fee, presale and liquidation behavior in _transfer
_maxBuyEnabled toggles the max transaction amount check in _transfer
openForPresale decides whether whitelist requirements are enforced in _transfer
liquidateTokensAtAmount is compared against the contract balance to trigger liquidation
_swapEnabled gates whether the contract may liquidate tokens during transfers
_dividendToken is used to build the swap path in swapTokensForDividendToken
_dividendToken is read to measure and transfer dividend balances in swapAndSendDividends
dividendToken is the token transferred externally in _withdrawDividendOfUser
withdrawnDividends accounting is updated around the external transfer in _withdrawDividendOfUser
magnifiedDividendPerShare feeds the withdrawable dividend computation used by _withdrawDividendOfUser
gasForProcessing is read to bound the dividend tracker process call in _transfer
gasForProcessing value flows into the tracker process loop budget
